limitations: Scripted states exercise the contract, not the candidate policy distribution or strength.
Static fair-play inventory requires manual source review.
Timing is local observed wall time, not a universal worst-case bound.

manual_checklist: Only supplied own cards, visible board, legal bounds and public action history inform strategy.
No deck/deal reconstruction from RNG, match/hand identifiers, environment or timing.
No opponent-name branches, withheld seed tables, engine imports or external I/O.
Memory resets per series, and only public observations enter it.
Preserve full Treys MIT notice and provenance when evaluator code is present.
Inspect all new imports and dynamic access; this AST inventory is not a security proof.
